articles.headline: France vs. Iraq delayed amid thunderstorms in Philadelphia

articles.description: It's another week of 2026 FIFA World Cup action, and we have some big teams playing today, including Argentina, France and Norway.

articles.headline: Messi shows why he's the G.O.A.T. with record-breaking goals
articles.description: Amazing doesn't even begin to describe Lionel Messi, whose two goals in Argentina's win over Austria made him the top men's or women's World Cup scorer. And he's not done yet.

articles.headline: Inside the Socceroos' plans to make history in the World Cup knockouts
articles.description: Hayden Foxe has tells ESPN extensive work has been done to ensure the Socceroos will be ready to pursue a first-ever knockout stage win regardless of where they end up after the Paraguay clash.

articles.headline: Ghana's Thomas Partey 'ready' for England, visa issues 'out of control'
articles.description: Thomas Partey has said he is "ready to play" against England on Tuesday after being denied entry to Canada for Ghana's World Cup opener.
